title: Communities & Global Summaries
description: Study community detection concepts, hierarchical summarization, global question answering, and summary refresh and dependency tracking. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Community detection concepts
lessons.description: Compare community assignments and inspect the supporting relation patterns.
lessons.conceptOverview: Community methods group nodes with relatively dense connections under a chosen objective. Results depend on graph construction and algorithm settings; communities are analytical groupings rather than guaranteed real-world categories.
lessons.whyItMatters: Community structure depends on modeling and algorithm choices.

lessons.title: Hierarchical summarization
lessons.description: Design a drill-down path from summary to original evidence.
lessons.conceptOverview: Summaries can aggregate evidence at multiple levels, but each compression step may lose detail. Retain links to underlying assertions and distinguish summary statements from direct source quotations.
lessons.whyItMatters: Hierarchical summaries need traceable supporting evidence.

lessons.title: Global question answering
lessons.conceptOverview: Global retrieval aggregates relevant summaries or evidence across the corpus. Control coverage and deduplication so repeated mentions do not masquerade as independent support.
lessons.whyItMatters: Global analysis should account for duplicated evidence.

lessons.title: Summary refresh and dependency tracking
lessons.description: Define which summaries become stale after a merge correction.
lessons.conceptOverview: When source assertions change, affected summaries may need regeneration or invalidation. Track dependencies and versions so global answers do not combine new edges with obsolete summaries.
lessons.whyItMatters: Derived summaries need explicit freshness management.
